title: Shared Presence, Session Colors and Universal Artifact Creation
description:
Make collaboration observable end to end for dev user 1 and user 2 against one hub.

1) Every artifact kind can be created within a space: replace the space plugin's hardcoded KNOWN_ARTIFACT_KINDS with a host-resolved manifest control (ActionArgControl::ArtifactKind{roles} + SurfaceApp{roles,dialect_arg}), stamp io.document_schema in PluginBuilder::editor/viewer, freeze the os.open-artifact relay args {artifactRef,documentId,spaceId,schema,role?,pluginId?,appId?}, fix the React relay (it required pluginId/appId that were never sent) and the wgpu relay (never switched plugin), and give the wgpu shell real staged-arg dialogs (it had no HostEffect::OpenDialog handling at all).

2) All editors and viewers share persistence AND presence, with presence defined for both artifacts and apps: artifact presence (interaction selection/hover per domain, cameras/views in artifact coordinates) renders from every peer of the document regardless of surface; app presence (app-typed presence pack, drag ghost, data-ui-path hover/focus/press) renders only from same-surface peers. The hub roster becomes document-wide (surface_fanout deleted; surface travels inside PresencePeer).

3) Every user gets a unique color for the session: hub-authoritative, space-wide lowest-free palette index handed out via a new ServerFrame::Session{actor,color}, released on last disconnect; 12-hue palette with light/dark theme tokens and Rust/TS twins; the FNV actor-hash hue is deleted. Local hover/selection and peer marks/cursors/cameras/carets all render in the owning session's color in BOTH renderers (React + wgpu), across 3D scenes, maps, canvases, node graphs, text editors, tables/trees/lists.

Wire: PresencePeer flag byte becomes a varint bitmask; cursor/viewport are replaced by views: Vec<PresenceWindowView{window_id,space,kind:Canvas|Orbit|Geo,size,pointer?}>; add color, surface, ui:PresenceUi. CHANNEL_VERSION 12: AppFrame::Ephemeral gains interaction bytes, new AppCommand::Presence is the plugin ingress (peers never reached plugins before), VcsArtifactApp assembles PresenceInteraction from InteractionState with zero app code and stamps UiPresence.color/peers.

Verification: extend the collab e2e harness (currently 2/8) with a matrix — unique colors, hover/selection propagation, camera propagation in 3D and maps, text carets, table row marks, cross-surface editor-viewer — over writer/draw/dag/cad/gis/space, a creation smoke over every wasm-buildable non-stdio kind, a wgpu-in-browser replay and a native wgpu smoke.

Plan file: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/achieve-the-following-end-cosmic-donut.md. Coordinator: Opus 5 High main chat; workers: Sonnet 5 High lanes; scouts/audits: Haiku 4.5. Forbidden territory: stdio plugins and world.wit (FULL-STDIO ticket still open).
